entities.name: 1916 Ürkün Revolt

entities.summary: The 1916 Central Asian Revolt against conscription, the catastrophic Russian reprisals, and the Ürkün (Exodus) — the mass flight of Kyrgyz to China resulting in the death of an estimated one-third of the Kyrgyz population.
